rationale: Temporary withdrawal of 386.85 acres in New Mexico 'until March 5, 1924'; the order says that on that date the lands become subject to disposal 'without further order' unless legislation is enacted or other directions are given. Own-terms end: 1924-03-05, recorded inclusive per owner ruling 2026-10-21 (exclusive alternative: ends when that day begins, 1924-03-04 end of day). Actor: the order itself (President Harding); mechanism: own-terms sunset. No held text (cruden zero citing hits; no held later order on these lands) shows an extension, permanent withdrawal or other direction before that date, so no contrary act is held; an unheld extension would be a separate instrument. Source is a compiled transcription (acceptable_as_original: false): original not yet held; replace and re-check quotes when an official copy is retrieved.
material_gaps: Absence of an extension/permanent-withdrawal act before 1924-03-05 is inferred from held corpus silence, not proven; check land-office records / Richardson / Statutes

sources.quote: temporarily withdrawn from settlement, entry, sale, or other disposition until March 5, 1924
they will on that date become subject to disposal under any law then applicable thereto without further order
This order supersedes and takes the place of Executive Order No. 3351, dated November 6, 1920.
